subject: general
question: Which of the following can be the most appropriate title of the passage?

options.text: Retracing Traditional and Local Wisdom of Eating
A Heady Mix of History and Meals
The Menace of Large Carbon Footprint

solution:
The correct answer is "**Retracing Traditional and Local Wisdom of Eating**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **most appropriate title** for the passage is "**Retracing Traditional and Local Wisdom of Eating.**"
 
• The **passage** discusses the **importance of traditional and local food cultures in India** and the **need to protect and promote them through the Slow Food Movement**.
 
• It also highlights the **negative impact of fast food on the environment and the importance of reducing carbon footprint**.
 
• Thus, ***option 1*** is the correct answer.
